notes.title: Seven New Anomalies
notes.content:
Paranormal Snap Shot - New Floors Update


7 New Floors & More Anomalies!
This update brings 7 eerie new floors filled with anomalies that sometimes mimic existing ones. While most floors follow the usual anomaly rules, some may now have multiple anomalies at once—but don’t expect this often! All new floors can be encountered in both Normal and Hard Mode, expanding the haunted school’s unsettling story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301562/1b60f448526145e97c74bd38432df27f8334e23e.png

A Balance of Terror
The response from the community has been amazing—your feedback, videos, and theories have truly made this game come to life. While some players wanted flashier jumpscares, Paranormal Snap Shot thrives on subtle, ambient horror. That said, for those who love a sudden fright (especially content creators), 1 or 2 new jumpscares have been added!

A Thank-You to the Fans
This update was never originally planned, but seeing how much people have loved the game and it's more unique mechanics, I wanted to give back with some extra content before moving on to my next horror project. I hope you enjoy the new floors, scares, and mysteries waiting to be discovered!

Happy hunting, and keep your eyes open... 👀

notes.title: Update v1.05
notes.content:
Update Patch Notes

A small content patch with some bug fixes and updates. The game now contains a simple loading screen as to not make loading so jarring and to display helpful tips players may find useful.


Bug Fixes;


Duplicate anomalies no longer appear on Hard Mode.
The ending screen now fades to black, stopping a bug where the player falls out of the world.

notes.title: Community Anomaly Ideas
notes.content:
With the 1.04 update and patch we've also added some extra levels to the game that the community have suggested to us!

First lets cover some quick patch notes;

Players we're confused about the 'Chime out of Time' aspect so a pop up tutorial has been added the first time the chime plays.
The starting room will now always have the same posters on the walls hinting at the previously mentioned chime and that some anomalies can only be seen through the camera.


Community Levels
Since the games release we've seen some similar ideas floating around, while it's just a start we added two of our favourites into the game with this update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301562/7110bf5be298cefb2cd9d7a3ea16d65e26621bdc.png

Good luck finding them anomaly hunters!
